title: topic_test
description: The blueprint for one topic's checkpoint test: the pool it draws from, the size and mix rules the draw obeys, and the pass rule. NOT a fixed question list — a sitting samples the pool with the attempt seed, so a retake is fresh. Layer C: size, mix and pass mark are pedagogy and every record carries needs_review. Built by scripts/export/build_topic_tests.py; see design/assessment.md §3.

x-yomineko.generated_by: HAND-AUTHORED — build_schemas.py lists it in BLUEPRINT (part of HANDWRITTEN) and must never write it. The RECORDS are generated by scripts/export/build_topic_tests.py and gated by scripts/validate/validate_topic_tests.py.

slug.description: `test:<topic slug without its prefix>` — test:n5-adjetivos for top:n5-adjetivos. One per tested topic. No level in the address: level is data (spec §1.6).

scope.description: Which items the test may ask about. `own` is the topic's own unlocks; `range` is every item unlocked between two topics, which is what a revisao topic tests. A topic with no testable item has no record at all and is listed in course/test_exemptions.json. Kana families are expanded to their glyphs (a kana question targets one glyph).

kind.description: Vocabulary owner: design — design/assessment.md#33-scope-size-mix-pass. Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.

from_topic.description: Inclusive start of a `range` scope. Null when kind is `own`.

items.description: The resolved scope set, stored rather than recomputed so the pool below can be checked against it without replaying the course.

mix.description: How many questions of each item kind the draw must place, and the two form floors. Computed from the scope, stored so a sitting does not recompute pedagogy at request time.

min_production.description: 1 when the pool holds a production question, else 0.

min_constructed.description: cloze or sentence_build: 1 when the pool holds one, else 0 (the kana, kanji-exame and saudações topics teach no constructed form).

pool.description: Every question the draw may use. `source` records where it came from, in the priority order of design/assessment.md §3.3; `item_refs` is the shared ItemRef shape and is what the mix and the mistake index read.

ref.description: `ex:` for a lesson exercise, or an exam-bank item id.

form.description: The question form, from the exercise type enum. Vocabulary owner: design — design/lesson_schema.md ('Exercise records', the ten `type` values).

item_refs.description: What the question tests inside this test's scope, same entry shape as lesson.exercises[].item_refs — see design/assessment.md §2.5.

criterion.description: Names the parameter block, so a changed threshold is a NEW value and rows evaluated under the old one stay readable — the device lesson_progress.mastery uses for MASTERY_V1. Vocabulary owner: design — design/assessment.md#33-scope-size-mix-pass.
